summary: Custom GLSL material for SOP/POP geometry. Supports vertex, pixel, and optional geometry shader stages, TD-specific uniforms/functions, explicit shader attribute declarations for POP workflows, samplers, vectors, matrices, specialization constants, deformation data, and render-state controls such as blending, depth test, alpha test, wireframe, cull face, and polygon offset.

common_gotchas: Compile failures display a blue/red checkerboard material; inspect Errors or Info CHOP/Info DAT output for the shader compiler message.
For POP-compatible attributes, declare attributes on the Attributes page and access them with TDAttrib_<Name>() rather than raw in declarations.
Sampler declarations must match the TOP dimensionality, such as sampler2D for 2D TOPs and sampler3D for 3D TOPs; configure filtering and extend modes on the Samplers page.
Lighting Space defaults to World Space; legacy Camera Space is for older 088-era shader assumptions.
When geometry has been through Bone Group SOP, pCaptPath may be split into bone group attributes such as pCaptPath0, so match the group rendered by this material.
Depth Test controls whether fragments compare against the Depth-Buffer, while Depth Writing controls whether passing fragments update it.
Use Polygon Depth Offset for z-fighting, shadow, or coplanar-surface cases, not as a general position fix.
